dedupe_keys.name: lod2 de official 3d building model of germany adv and state lod2 open data

description: LoD2-DE is the official 3D building model of Germany at level of detail 2, holding about 58 million above-ground buildings and structures with standardised roof shapes aligned to the actual ridge lines. Footprints usually come from the official cadastre, and attributes in the AdV product and quality standard include object identifier, link to the 2D building, production date, building function, measured height, generalised roof form, municipality key, footprint currency and data source, with name, storeys, address and terrain intersection where available. The central office ZSHH at the Bavarian LDBV bundles the state data and supplies it nationwide in a single CityGML format, updated yearly, in ETRS89 UTM zones 32 and 33. Coverage: all of Germany. Access: nationwide supply from ZSHH with free test data, or free downloads from each state portal, which the AdV page lists with Open Data or HVD status. Licence: open data for the state datasets; the nationwide product is charged under the AdV fee directive, from 16,000 euro. Caveats: roof shapes are generalised, and attributes such as storeys and address are optional. Simulation uses listed by AdV include volume for insurance and energy demand, shadow analysis, mobile network planning, solar cadastres and emergency management. Related records: the OGC CityGML standard and the enriched Lower Saxony residential LoD2 dataset.
